# Adobe Photoshop handoff checklist

Consult this reference when adobe photoshop handoff checklist is relevant to the selected task. Extract the specific constraint or example you need, verify version-sensitive behavior against the active toolchain, and return to the task rather than loading unrelated references.

- Record input file paths and final output filenames.
- Capture final dimensions, color space, and export format.
- Note unresolved manual edits and reviewer follow-ups.
- Escalate generation requests to `ai-media:imagegen` when needed.
